messages:
incbot: INCIDENT ALERT: Multiple 5xx and TCP RSTs observed from euc2 ingress starting 2026-02-18T09:07:14Z. Impact: increased client errors and failed connections to hosted inference endpoints in euc2. Paging oncall.
oncall_mike: saw the page, I'm on it. Investigating LB/Envoy metrics now.
sre_ana: joining — grabbing envoy stats and NLB target health. Early hint: surge of RST from upstream at 09:06:xx, concurrent with a control-plane flurry.
eng-runtime: ping — any service-level errors in the runtime? I'm checking RPC latencies to GPUs.
netops_lina: looking at VPC flow logs, I see a few thousand SYN,RST combos from ALB-NLB fronting envoy at 09:06:xx. Could be connection churn from backends.
oncall_mike: here's envoy error snippet:
```
[2026-02-18T09:06:21Z] envoy upstream reset: connection reset by peer, code=RST_STREAM
[2026-02-18T09:06:22Z] envoy upstream connect failure, host=10.12.45.78:4949
```
support_jai: support is getting flood of customer errors, several high-tier customers reporting 502s. Logged ticket INC-3492.
product_ops: customers reporting partial feature degradation (chat timeouts). Prioritizing SLA-sensitive tenants.
sre_ana: NLB health checks show a rapid state change on several targets in euc2b AZ, healthcheck 502 -> unhealthy within ~30s.
eng-runtime: I see backend process CPU spike on a few pods and memory GC pauses. Could be overload causing accept queue drops.
oncall_mike: mitigation idea: shift a % of traffic away from euc2 to euc1 while we triage. Can we do weighted DNS / traffic-split quickly?
netops_lina: we can apply a weighted Route53 failover within ~3-4m (lower TTL already 60s). Recommend 30% shift first.
incbot: ACTION: create incident channel #inc-2128001234 and post status updates; escalation to SRE lead if not resolved in 15m.
sre_ana: scaling ingress replica count + bumping connection timeout on envoy (from 30s -> 60s) to reduce premature resets. Applying now.
eng-runtime: adding CPU pad to pods and restarting worst-offending pod set. Rolling restart kickstarted.
support_jai: notif to affected customers drafted, will send an interim message explaining mitigation and ETA.
oncall_mike: netops — please start weighted DNS change to move 30% to euc1 now.
netops_lina: done — Route53 record updated: euc2 weight 70, euc1 weight 30. TTL 60s. Monitor.
product_ops: posting update to status page: "Partial outage in euc2 affecting API responses; mitigation underway — traffic being shifted to euc1."
incbot: NOTE: external routing change observed at 09:10:xx; expect traffic shift propagation in ~1-2min.
eng-runtime: metrics after scaling: pod accept queue drops reduced by ~80% on restarted nodes. Error rate dropping but still elevated due to some unhealthy backends.
sre_ana: NLB target re-registration in progress. Removing suspect instances from target group, draining then re-registering.
netops_lina: discovered unusual SYN retries originating from a specific host pool that maps to a third-party CNI upgrade earlier today. Rolling back the CNI change on that pool.
oncall_mike: CNI rollback confirmed on the pool; health checks recovering.
support_jai: sent status update to impacted customers and set expectation of next update in 15m. :email:
product_ops: status page updated again, noted partial recovery.
eng-runtime: final check: 5xx rate in euc2 trending down to baseline over last 4m. Latency normalizing. Suggest keep weight at 70% for 10m then re-evaluate.
sre_ana: agree. Keep oncall monitoring for 30m. Leaving a note to root-cause follow-up: investigate CNI upgrade interactions with NLB connection handling and kube-proxy conntrack settings.
incbot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident severity lowered. Please file postmortem and include timeline, customers impacted, and remediation tasks. :white_check_mark:
support_jai: created customer-impact report draft and linked tickets. Will attach to postmortem.
oncall_mike: handing off monitoring to SRE rota. Logged as handed off to oncall @sre-night. Closing active pager. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
